authorship: AI-authored draft; not sampled from real user traffic; human question review pending
independence_scope: New query holdout against the existing Seoul tourism corpus; not an unseen-corpus or external-domain benchmark

comparison.model_revisions: Must record installed revisions and runtime configuration before collection; not inferred from model names

primary_metric: paired mean NDCG@10 on primary cases with at least one human-confirmed relevant pooled result
uncertainty: Paired cluster bootstrap by query family, not by individual paraphrase; report a 95% interval, evaluated counts and win/tie/loss
family_policy: Related entity, theme, noisy and translated questions share a family; equal family weight for aggregate inference
challenge_policy: Report evidence_sensitive and out_of_scope separately; no assumed zero relevance labels and no addition to primary ranking means
no_relevant_policy: Report count and returned-result behavior separately. No relevant pooled result does not prove no relevant place exists in the full corpus
label_policy: Blind pooled top-10 union, 0..3 relevance or unknown; missing evidence remains unknown, never automatic zero; all pooled rows require review
success_policy: No automatic pass threshold. Assess effect size and uncertainty together; no positive superiority conclusion if the interval crosses zero
reuse_policy: Once results influence settings, this dataset becomes development data. A subsequent final evaluation requires new questions
